findings.finding: The plan's closed inventory of prev-shape-sensitive consumers ('The prev-shape-sensitive consumers exercised here are `check_dual_identity_complete` and the differ's local-only / emit-both arms ... The binding walk consumes `curr_snapshot` ... so it is unaffected') omits the outbound differ's consumption of prev_snapshot FIELD VALUES as a field-diff arbitration baseline. run_differs.py:523 threads `prev_snapshot=prev_snapshot` into `compute_outbound_mutations`; it reaches `outbound_field_diff` (line 196: `raw_baseline = (prev_snapshot or {}).get(jira_key)`) and `outbound_fields._local_matches_prev` / `_jira_matches_prev`, which read per-key title/description/priority/status/assignee bodies — precisely the bodies the `{jira_key: {}}` narrowing zeroes. In production these are superseded by `binding_store.get_baseline(local_id)` (outbound_fields.py:402-403, story d6bd), but the plan neither names this consumer nor cites that supersession invariant, so the safety of narrowing for it is asserted-by-omission rather than derived.
findings.location: Shape-constraint paragraph: 'The prev-shape-sensitive consumers exercised here are check_dual_identity_complete and the differ's local-only / emit-both arms ... The binding walk consumes curr_snapshot ... so it is unaffected.'
scenarios: outbound_field_diff.py:196 — on any code path where the binding_store baseline is None/absent and the prev_snapshot fallback is taken, `raw_baseline` becomes `{}` under the key-set shape, so `_local_matches_prev` returns False (degrade-to-local-wins), silently changing the inbound-mirror suppression decision; the plan's inventory never accounts for this consumer.

outbound_fields.py:275 `_jira_matches_prev` — same prev-body dependence for both-sides-conflict detection (bug a713); an emptied baseline suppresses conflict detection, an effect not covered by the plan's enumerated arms or its G1 corpus (which exercises only compute_mutations + drop_snapshot_differ_local_state_emissions).

findings.finding: The plan's motivating 'It also removes a latent bug' claim — that today's full prev emits 973-998 spurious (outbound, create) mutations whose 'payload shape DOES reach create_one' — overstates the production consequence. Those unbound_local creates are already suppressed at the call site by drop_snapshot_differ_local_state_emissions (bug d103, ADR 0028), so they do NOT reach create_one at HEAD. The key-set does avoid emitting them from compute_mutations, but it is not fixing a create that currently reaches Jira.
